title: Routing report counts all assigned-task dollars per accepted merge
body:
Astra audit routing (E5 verified: rows lack realized model): routing trials count merged tasks only (src/outcome/dollars.ts), not all assigned-task dollars per independently accepted merge.
Files: evals/routing/report.ts, src/outcome/dollars.ts
Outcome: node evals/routing/report.ts --all-attempts prints dollars per accepted merge per role and model including retries, reviewer and abandoned work.
Proof: node evals/routing/report.ts --all-attempts exits 0 on the recorded outcome ledger.
